task.summary:
test: add database integration tests
- Add comprehensive test suite for database operations - Implement test cases for operators, satellites, telecommands, and execution logs - Add test for get_satellite_command_stats function - Configure test database connection using environment variables - Ensure test isolation and proper cleanup - Add type hints and docstrings for better maintainability
The test suite verifies that all basic CRUD operations work as expected with the existing database schema and data.

feat: implement Operator model with comprehensive test suite
- Add Operator model with SQLAlchemy ORM mapping - Implement password hashing and verification - Add input validation and constraints - Include comprehensive test suite with 11 test cases - Set up test database configuration - Add type hints and docstrings for better maintainability
The Operator model includes: - Core fields: username, email, full_name, password - Role-based access control (admin/operator/viewer) - Account status management - Automatic timestamps for creation and last login - Secure password handling with werkzeug.security
Tests cover: - Database connection and table structure - CRUD operations - Data validation and constraints - Password hashing and verification - Role and status validation

feat: implement Satellite model with comprehensive test suite
- Add Satellite model with SQLAlchemy ORM mapping - Include automatic timestamp management (created_at, updated_at) - Add status validation with allowed values: active, inactive, maintenance - Implement 12 test cases covering CRUD operations and validations - Set up test database configuration for satellite tests - Add type hints and docstrings for better maintainability
The Satellite model includes: - Core fields: name, code, description, status - Automatic timestamp management - Status validation - Relationship with Telecommand model (commented for now) - to_dict() method for JSON serialization
Tests cover: - Database connection and table structure - CRUD operations - Field validations (required fields, status values) - Code uniqueness constraint - Timestamp auto-updates - Data integrity checks
Dependencies: - SQLAlchemy for ORM - pytest for testing - PostgreSQL for database
feat: implement telecommand model with comprehensive test suite

feat: implement core models, comprehensive tests, and web dashboard
**Models:** - Refactor `Operator`, `Satellite`, `Telecommand`, and `ExecutionLog` models. - Implement proper SQLAlchemy relationships and database constraints (Foreign Keys, Check Constraints). - Fix timezone handling (ensure UTC awareness) and server-side defaults for timestamps. - Update `Telecommand` logic to reassign to Admin (ID 1) upon Operator deletion.
**Tests:** - Add comprehensive test suite using `pytest` for all models. - Implement "Separation of Concerns" pattern: split tests into `Behavior` (Logic) and `Persistence` (DB Integration). - Fix transaction management in tests using `begin_nested` and proper rollback strategies. - Enable Foreign Key support for SQLite in test environment.
**Web Interface:** - Initialize Flask application structure (App Factory pattern, Blueprints). - Create `web_routes` for Dashboard, Create, and Delete operations. - Implement Bootstrap 5 frontend with `base.html` layout and `index.html` dashboard. - Add Dashboard Cards (Pending, Sent, History) and Modals for interaction.
**Configuration:** - Update `DatabaseManager` to allow explicit database type selection (PostgreSQL vs SQLite). - Create `run.py` entry point.

feat(ui): implement mission control dashboard and json parameter editor
- Redesign web interface with a modern, dark-themed "Mission Control" UI. - Add responsive sidebar for Satellites and Operators status. - Implement interactive Dashboard with real-time counters (Pending, Sent, History). - Add AJAX-based JSON editor for Telecommand parameters (view/edit/save). - Create API endpoint `POST /telecommand/update/<id>` for parameter updates. - Improve UX with modal-based workflows for creation, details, and deletion.

fix(ui): resolve modal interaction issues and enable full telecommand editing
- Fix HTML attribute quoting in `onclick` handlers to support JSON payloads (resolves modal not opening). - Implement client-side search/filtering for the "All Telecommands" table. - Upgrade Details Modal to a full Editing Form: - Allow editing of Satellite, Command Type, Priority, and Status. - Keep Operator field read-only for audit purposes. - Pre-fill all fields correctly using data from the backend. - Update `saveTelecommand` JS function to submit all modified fields to the API.
feat: initial commit of Satellite TC Generator Web

feat(satellite): implement full CRUD management via interactive modal
- Add `onclick` event to the satellite list in the sidebar to open a dedicated management modal. - Create a new modal (`satelliteModal`) for editing satellite details (Name, Code, Status, and Description). - Implement a "Create New" button in the modal, allowing users to clone an existing satellite's data to create a new entry. - Add backend API endpoints for satellite Create, Update, and Delete (`/satellite/create`, `/satellite/update/<id>`, `/satellite/delete/<id>`). - Implement server-side validation to handle unique satellite codes (`IntegrityError`) and return user-friendly error messages. - Enhance the delete functionality with a confirmation dialog that warns the user about the cascading deletion of associated telecommands.

style(ui): add project logo to header for improved branding
- Insert SpaceLab Ground Station logo into the main header of `index.html`. - Adjust header layout to accommodate the new visual identity. - Enhance the professional look and feel of the Mission Control dashboard.

feat(infra): add docker support for automated deployment
- Create `Dockerfile` for the Flask application. - Create `docker-compose.yml` to orchestrate the Web App, PostgreSQL, and PGAdmin. - Configure automatic database initialization using `schema.sql` on container startup. - Update `readme.md` with comprehensive instructions for Docker and local execution. - Add `.env.example` for environment configuration.
update: updated docker support for automated deployment
